name: status
description: Current camera state: model, exposure mode, shutter speed, aperture, exposure compensation, ISO, battery, whether the card is being written, focus result, app UI state (LIVE, FN, MENU, AF_MOVE), position of the flexible spot, AE lock and all currently visible settings with their value. Keys are German (e.g. modus = mode, zeit = shutter speed, blende = aperture, akku = battery).

name: einstellungen
description: Lists settings with internal value, display text and all possible values. Without arguments only the settings that matter right now. The id and a value from 'werte' (values) are needed for einstellung_setzen.

gruppe.description: Only one group: Aufnahme (shooting), Belichtung (exposure), Bild (picture), Fokus (focus) or Blitz (flash)

alle.description: Also show settings that do not matter right now or are not available

name: einstellung_setzen
description: Sets a setting. 'wert' (value) is the internal value or the display text (e.g. 'burst-high' or 'Continuous Hi'). Returns whether the camera accepted the value, and the value afterwards.

id.description: Id of the setting, e.g. iso, ev, wb, drive, dro, afarea

name: belichtung
description: Changes shutter speed, aperture, program shift or exposure compensation by whole steps, like the dials. What is possible depends on the mode (e.g. shutter speed only in S and M).

schritte.description: Detents like on the dial, positive clockwise, negative counter-clockwise; -10 to 10

name: fokus
description: Focuses like a half-pressed shutter button and reports the result (OK, FAILED or NONE). With halten=true (hold) the shutter stays half pressed until fokus_loesen is called.

name: fokus_loesen
description: Releases the half-pressed shutter button.

name: ausloesen
description: Focuses and takes a picture, like a fully pressed shutter button. Only works with shutter control by the app.

name: taste
description: Presses a camera button in the app, e.g. to operate the Fn grid or the menu. Afterwards bild with quelle 'anzeige' shows what is on screen.

anzahl.description: How many times to press, default 1, at most 20

name: fokusfeld
description: Moves the flexible spot (focus area 'Flexible spot'). dx/dy in grid steps (17 × 11 like on the camera), or mitte=true (center), or x/y directly in the range -1000 to 1000 relative to the picture.

name: ael
description: AE lock: an=true holds the current exposure, an=false releases it.

name: bild
description: Returns pictures: 'live' is the viewfinder picture as JPEG, 'anzeige' the app display (status line, Fn grid, menus) as PNG in the correct aspect ratio, 'beides' both pictures.

name: log
description: Last lines of the app log (buttons, settings, errors, camera responses).

name: parameter
description: Diagnostics: reads the raw camera parameters (key=value) and optionally sets them directly, without the app's checks. 'filter' limits the output to keys containing the text. 'setzen' (set) is an object key → value. The response reports whether the camera accepted, and the values afterwards.

name: dateien
description: Lists files on the memory card: 'OMKAMERA' (time-lapse movies, settings), 'DCIM' (newest picture folder) or a subfolder such as 'DCIM/10061114'.

name: jpeg_test
description: Diagnostics: re-encodes a JPEG from the memory card with Sony's hardware JpegExporter at several quality levels and reports file size and errors per level. Without 'datei' (file) the newest JPEG in the DCIM folder is used. The test files go to OMKTEST on the card and can be removed with loeschen=true.

stufen.description: Quality values for the exporter, default 1, 2, 3

loeschen.description: Delete the test files after measuring, default true

name: rawtest
description: Experiment stage 3c: takes the RAW data of the next shot(s) via Sony's shutter sequence callback. modus 'durchreiche' (pass-through) develops one picture with the standard filter and saves it, 'addition' adds 'anzahl' pictures (2–8) with the RAW addition filter, 'hdr' takes three pictures (0, −EV, +EV; anzahl = EV distance 1–3, default 2) and develops them with the HDR filter, 'status' returns the result of the last attempt. Details are in the log (lines 'rawlab').

name: verarbeiten
description: Stage 3c: converts ARW files on the card in the app or combines several. art 'dng' (lossless, with lens data), 'tiff' (16 bit) or 'png' (16 or 8 bit, simple development to sRGB) for the newest ARW or 'datei' (file); 'heic' and 'avif' (experimental, 8 bit, tile grid, slow); 'mittel' (average), 'summe' (sum), 'maximum' (star trails) and 'fokus' (focus stacking) for the newest 'anzahl' ARWs, result as DNG. 'status' shows progress and the last result, 'abbrechen' cancels. Results are stored in OMKAMERA on the card.

datei.description: Name or path of an ARW, e.g. DSC05935.ARW

anzahl.description: Number of newest ARWs to combine, default 3

bit.description: Color depth for PNG, remembered as a setting

name: zeitraffer
description: Stage 4: time-lapse (LRT). aktion 'status' shows the state, 'rampe' starts an interval ramp to 'ziel' seconds within 'minuten' minutes, 'rampe_stopp' stops it, 'heller'/'dunkler' (brighter/darker) moves the Holy Grail reference by 1/3 EV, 'setzen' sets an option like in the menu ('schluessel' (key) and 'wert' (value): interval in tenths of a second, count, bulb seconds, at 0/1 = delay/time of day, ath/atm start time, delay, win 0/1, wfrom/wto hour, wdays bit mask Mon=1, hg 0/1/-1, isomax, isomin, film frames/s, rampto, rampmin). It is started with the sequence 'Time-lapse (LRT)' and the shutter button.

minuten.description: Duration of the ramp in minutes

name: objektiv
description: Manual lens (lens without contacts, only on cameras that report it – e.g. a7 models): writes name, focal length and aperture into the EXIF data of every picture and sets SteadyShot to this focal length. Without arguments it shows the state. 'an'=false switches back to the camera's own data.

an.description: switch the lens data on or off

name.description: lens name for the EXIF, e.g. 'Helios 44-2 58mm F2'; empty = built from focal length and aperture

blende_offen.description: largest aperture of the lens, e.g. 2

blende.description: aperture set on the lens, e.g. 5.6

name: uhr
description: Clock: 'status' shows the time the app works with (log, time-lapse start time, time window) and the camera's Sony clock (EXIF, folder names) with its deviation. 'ntp' syncs with the time server (router or pool.ntp.org, EU summer time); 'setzen' takes 'zeit_ms' (ms since 1970, UTC) from the PC. The a6000 does not let apps set its Sony clock; the app then remembers the deviation and works with the correct time.

zeit_ms.description: current time in ms since 1970 (UTC), only for 'setzen'

name: system
description: System diagnostics with root rights on the Linux side of the camera, read-only and fixed queries only: 'system' (kernel, uptime, load, memory, cores and clock), 'speicher' (/proc/meminfo), 'prozesse' (all processes by memory use), 'log' (last 600 lines of the Android log without battery messages), 'ablauf' (app switching, Android sleep and wake-up), 'cpu' (processor).
